**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 3 (the ladders, area by area): all 22 areas have a ladder, and `bun nv scaling --areas` prints `every area has a ladder`.** `bun nv scaling` in `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts` measures six kinds (`run`, `compile`, `lsp`, `fmt`, `serve`, `fetch`); its module doc is the home of the ramp, the bounds, `KINDS`, `AREAS`, the `serve` sizes and the `fetch` server (`withServer`, `FETCH_URL_ENV`). Tests: `tools/nv/test/scaling.test.ts`.

**New this session, both flat:** `http-client/response.nvs` (`kind fetch`: downloads one body of 16 KB to 1 MB from `http-client/response/server.nvs`; the client allocates about 5 bytes per body byte, linearly) and `app/requests.nvs` (`kind serve`, `size requests`: one shop page per request with a session in Redis at 127.0.0.1:16379, SQLite, `Core\Validate`, an HTML list, JSON and `Core\Cache::local`; peak memory flat to 4096 requests).

**`app` is one ladder of the several the goal prose describes under Stage 3:** rows per page, routes in the program, clients at once, and the same app generated at n modules for `compile` and `lsp` are not written. It has no queued job yet: the queue needs the `nvs_jobs` tables `queue/jobs.nvs` creates.

**Ladders that grow:** `fmt/classes.nvs`, `lsp/classes.nvs`, and `numbers/bigint-mul.nvs` (allocations at slope 1.85, clock follows Toom-3; under *Benches to look at*). `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` *What we found* has the 1.05 MB per `Core\Task`, an unread POST body of 16 KB and over losing its response, and more than about 100 headers not being answered on a kept-alive connection; none of their causes is checked.

**Still red:** `--areas --reviewed` (`docs/perf/performance-review.md` does not exist, Stage 4) and `scaling --check` (the growing ladders, Stage 5). `lspInstructions` has not run, and `--iterations --check` has had no full sweep.

items.text: **The `app` ladders the goal still names**: rows per page (a `run` ladder over the same page logic with `Bench::run(size)`, or a `serve` ladder whose size is read from the query) and clients at once (`size connections`), beside `benches/scaling/app/requests.nvs:1`. If a size needs a new `SERVE_SIZES` entry, it goes in `serveShape` at `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:621`. Rule: `rule:testing/bench-counters`.

**The app at n modules** for `compile` and `lsp`: a `compile` ladder that prints the shop with n route classes, as `benches/scaling/compiler/functions.nvs:1` does, at `benches/scaling/app/modules.nvs`. Rule: `rule:testing/bench-counters`.

**Check the two server findings** in `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` with `curl` against `nvs serve`: the unread POST body at 16 KB and over (`benches/scaling/request/body.nvs:1`), and more than about 100 headers on a kept-alive connection (`benches/scaling/request/headers.nvs:1`). Name each cause's `file:line` or record it as a gap owned by `performance-pass`.
